issues.title: The two-photon E05b rejection bucket does determine M
issues.location: paper/sections/05_experiments.tex, paragraph beginning At sizes n=4,6,8; v2/full-source.tex:262; prepared unit sections/006-reconciled-computations-and-negative-optimization-result.tex:31
issues.quote: The simulator retains the total non-CF mass as an explicit rejection category, without resolving its internal collision histogram; the E05b traces therefore cannot estimate the pair moment $M$.
issues.analysis: The stated E05b grid includes the lossless bosonic arm n=4,k=2. Every two-photon occupation is either two distinct unit occupations (CF, pair count zero) or one occupation two (non-CF, pair count one). Thus sum_i binom(t_i,2)=1_{non-CF} for every outcome, and M=1-P_CF exactly for that arm. The rejection category, or its finite-shot frequency, therefore determines or estimates M without a collision histogram. The source itself defines M as this pair expectation at v2/full-source.tex:80-86. For k>=3, unresolved non-CF mass does not generally determine the pair moment, so the intended limitation is valid there. This is a local exception in the empirical-observability statement, not a defect in either theorem.
issues.suggested_fix: Restrict the non-identifiability claim to k>=3 (n>=6) and state that in the two-photon bosonic arm M=1-P_CF exactly. Preserve the caveat that this does not by itself certify the intensity floor c or finite-data uncertainty.

issues.title: Density caption contains a doubled control backslash before Phi
issues.location: Figure labelled fig:density, paper/sections/05_experiments.tex; v2/full-source.tex:299; prepared unit sections/006-reconciled-computations-and-negative-optimization-result.tex:68
issues.analysis: The exact source has two consecutive U+005C characters before the letters Phi, rather than the single-backslash Phi control sequence used in the envelope definition and coarse bound at v2/full-source.tex:92 and :99. Under TeX tokenization this starts the double-backslash command and then the letters Phi; it is not the defined envelope symbol. This observation is source-only: no PDF rendering or compilation failure is asserted. The mathematical caption plainly intends the already defined coarse envelope.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace $\\Phi(M/c)$ by $\Phi(M/c)$ in the caption source, leaving the theorem and data unchanged.

finding_summary: No new defect found in the mathematical core. Two localized v2 findings: the unrestricted rejection-bucket statement misses the k=2 exception; the new density caption doubles the backslash before Phi.

checks.result_details: All hashes matched. Eight units are byte-identical. Four changed units are loss (caption only), experiments (methods/captions/notation), pilot (output-mode loss clarification and P40 formatting/macro), and reproducibility (path layout). The theorem/lemma statement list is identical after source-offset normalization. The full extracted preamble is identical after removing only providecommand CalibrationCellCount=45.

checked_context: V remains an orthonormal occupied frame with one identical photon in each distinct input; p_b and p_d are full unconditioned Fock laws with output factorial t!, not CF-renormalized laws.

M remains the expected bosonic pair count, delta the dominant-support leakage, and c a lower bound on every positive row intensity. The coarse bound selects the small quadratic branch only under M<c^2/2. No new average-density substitution or noisy-moment theorem application appears.

B is still a spatial magnitude Gram matrix, distinct from the internal-state Gram S. Cycle coefficient positivity, symmetry and sigma<1 for the infinite majorant are unchanged; the finite polynomial statement is unchanged.

Haar threshold source selection still assumes m even >=8, k=m/2, distinct injected photons, uniform independent loss, and k<=N<=m. eta=1 remains a separate endpoint. Root-order and fixed-s/lambda boundary calculations retain their old definitions.

The new output-mode-loss sentence explicitly says such loss cannot generally be commuted through the interferometer. It neither changes the uniform-loss theorem nor extends the lossless density certificate to uncorrected observed moments.
Calibration x=|S_12|^2 and the two-photon formulas are unchanged. The only new macro is 45=5*3*3 calibration cells; it does not redefine any theorem symbol or hypothesis.
checks.reuse_limit: The earlier tiny exact Fraction check MA-C008 remains historical finite evidence only; it was not rerun or presented as a new campaign. Whole-paper claims MA-C009 are not reused.

fresh_comparisons: The abstract, introduction and discussion still keep the positive row floor, fixed-c upper-envelope asymptotic, leading sharpness only at c=1/2, and collision-only spectator obstruction within their stated scope.

Same-circuit absolute event error remains separate from independently trained-model ordering and rare-event ratios. The negative archived benchmark is not generalized to all optical optimizers or to a wall-clock advantage claim.

The new E05b training description uses conditional cut plus 2(1-P_F), with an optimum-blind no-valid-event fallback sum w+3; since nonnegative costs are at most sum w, this fallback is worse than every ordinary value bounded by sum w+2. The retrospective optimum is expressly reserved for evaluation; E02 remains labeled oracle-assisted. This is source logic, not a new code audit.

Call and draw arithmetic remains 120*256+4096=34816; the new parameter counts n(n-1)=12,30,56 and n=4,6,8 are arithmetically correct. The source discloses differing dimensions, and input-column phases indeed contribute only one overall phase for a fixed-input Fock state.

Table/figure metrics are newly and explicitly identified as exact final probabilities after finite-shot training, rather than the noisy heldout success frequencies. Graph-cluster resampling now retains optimizer repeats and nominal multiplicities, and is explicitly descriptive rather than population-significance evidence. This clarifies interpretation; bootstrap correctness was not checked against data.
The new rejection-bucket limitation is overbroad at k=2, as MA2-F001 demonstrates. At k>=3 the missing collision multiplicities do generally obstruct identification of M.

P40 remains a 45-cell local prediction check with no fitting, sampling or optimization. Its new input pins and macro are visible in the publication manifest. These pins are not treated as independently validated execution receipts in this pass.

NoQPU status remains explicit: local serialization/compilation does not certify remote native support, synthetic counts are labeled local_synthetic, and detector/access/calibration/credit questions remain unverified. Finite-shot inference of c and M remains an open obligation.

Originality of the complete density composition remains OPEN. The source does not infer novelty from missing hits; authentic end-to-end ObliQ reproduction and strong submission conditions remain open. Bibliography bytes are unchanged.
